On_Farm_Confirmatory_Check: Inspect feed: cow is receiving only dry straw without green fodder or oilcake. Check rumen fill and rumen motility (normally 2-3 contractions per 2 minutes; will be sluggish/weak).
Actionable_Advice: Immediate protein and moisture supplementation required: provide 1-2 kg mustard/cottonseed/groundnut cake or commercial concentrate daily. Add 10-15 kg green succulent fodder (hybrid Napier, berseem). Ensure free-choice drinking water.
Abstain_Escalate_If: Coarse straw is external bedding dropped on top of pat -> brush off and retake.

Sub_Type_Name: Oak / Tannin or Heavy Metal Poisoning
Geometry_3D_Form: Very thick, dry, sticky mound passed in small painful quantities (height 1.5 - 2.5 in); holds vertical shape stiffly.
Top_Down_2D_Contour_Signature: Unusually dark, dense, constricted mound with glistening surface mucus sheaths and tight transverse constriction folds.
Central_Dimple_Morphology: Completely absent; constricted stiff mound.
Perimeter_Edge_Slope: Steep, abrupt perimeter walls (> 60 degrees).
Texture_And_Moisture_Class: Dense, rubbery, sticky, and tenaciously cohesive; difficult to break apart.
Radial_Bleed_Ring_Extent: ZERO BLEEDING. Fluid completely absent.
Substrate_Floor_Interaction: Clings tenaciously to concrete in small constricted piles.
Surface_Optical_Reflectance: Glossy mucous sheen over a dark, charcoal-brown body.
Biological_Sheen_Vs_Flash_Glare_Rule: Tenacious mucous coating creates localized shiny streaks. Flash glare creates white points; look at dark body and mucus streaks.
LAB_Centroids: #231B15=(11.5, 3.2, 5.8); #1A140E=(8.2, 1.8, 3.2) | tolerance dE2000<=12 under a calibrated reference; <=20 uncalibrated
Dietary_Color_Confounder_Disambiguation: Very dark color is caused by condensed tannins, iron salts, or early mucosal blood. Differentiate from simple dark browse by the severe constipation and colic signs.
Fiber_Mastication_And_Particle_Length: Dense compacted fine fiber; lacks normal porosity.
Gas_Bubbles_Foam_Morphology: STRICTLY BUBBLE-FREE.
Mucus_Fibrin_And_Blood_Morphology: MANDATORY MUCOUS ENVELOPE: Surface coated in a distinct translucent to cloudy mucus sheath due to colonic straining (tenesmus).
Freshness_Vs_Sun_Crust_Gate: Maintains rubbery, sticky texture for several hours.
Mandatory_Visual_Inclusions: VERY DARK CHARCOAL-BROWN TO BLACKISH COLOR; stiff constricted mound; prominent surface mucus sheen; small volume.
Mandatory_Visual_Exclusions: ABSENCE of liquid pooling; ABSENCE of gas bubbles; ABSENCE of green pasture color.
Primary_Structural_Discriminator: Stiff dark charcoal mound with prominent glistening mucus coating (tannin/toxic constipation).
Visual_Lookalike_Discriminator: vs 1-BLK: 4-POISON is stiff, dense, and stacked (height >1.5 in) with mucus; 1-BLK is completely flat liquid (<0.2 in).
Strict_Negative_Exclusion_Logic: IF sample is liquid watery puddle -> NEVER assign 4-POISON (consider 1-BLK).
Camera_Bias_And_Confounder_Gates: SHADOW GATE: Ensure dark color is genuine pigment and not deep barn shadow.
Animal_Context_Gate: Grazing cattle with access to scrub oak (Quercus), acorns, industrial run-off, or bracken fern.
Diagnosed_Clinical_Condition: Oak / Quercus Tannin Toxicity or Heavy Metal (Lead/Arsenic) Intoxication.
Root_Cause_Etiology: Hydrolysable tannins (gallotannins) bind mucosal proteins in the gastrointestinal tract and are metabolized to gallic acid and pyrogallol, causing severe nephrotoxicity, hepatotoxicity, and GI stasis characterized by severe initial constipation followed by hemorrhagic diarrhea.
Evidence_Basis: DOC + WEB-CORROBORATED (Quercus oak toxicity initial obstipation and mucous-coated dung)
On_Farm_Confirmatory_Check: Check pasture for scrub oak, fallen acorns, or industrial waste. Check cow for teeth grinding, depression, arched back (abdominal pain), and dark urine.
Actionable_Advice: EMERGENCY VETERINARY CALL: Remove cows from oak/pasture source immediately. Veterinary administration of mineral oil / laxatives, oral activated charcoal, calcium hydroxide (tannin antagonist), and aggressive IV fluid therapy to prevent acute kidney failure.
Abstain_Escalate_If: Shadow obscures color -> verify under bright light before declaring toxicity.

Geometry_3D_Form: PELLETED SEGMENTATION. Normal circular pat structure is 100% LOST. Passes as discrete, segmented, flattened oval balls or clumps stacking 2.0 to 4.0 inches in height.
Top_Down_2D_Contour_Signature: Cluster of individual, discrete, non-cohesive balls or oval nodules resembling equine or camelid manure; complete absence of a continuous circular pat disc.
Central_Dimple_Morphology: Completely absent; pat cohesion has completely broken down into separate individual balls.
Perimeter_Edge_Slope: Discrete isolated ball margins (> 80 degrees); individual pellets tumble freely.
Texture_And_Moisture_Class: Firm, dense, fibrous dry balls; crumbles into dry chunks or fibrous powder under footwear.
Radial_Bleed_Ring_Extent: ZERO BLEEDING. Severe colonic water reabsorption has removed all free moisture.
Substrate_Floor_Interaction: Rolls freely across dry concrete or bedding like horse droppings; zero adherence.
Surface_Optical_Reflectance: Dull dark brown to slate grey-black; may show faint superficial mucous sheen from colonic straining.
Biological_Sheen_Vs_Flash_Glare_Rule: Faint mucosal sheen from colonic straining is localized to pellet margins. Flash glare reflects off dry fibrous facets as white sparkles; evaluate distinct pellet geometry.
LAB_Centroids: #3B3226=(21.5, 4.2, 8.5); #2E2922=(17.2, 1.8, 5.2) | tolerance dE2000<=12 under a calibrated reference; <=20 uncalibrated
Dietary_Color_Confounder_Disambiguation: Dark slate brown color reflects prolonged retention in the colon (>72 hours). The PELLETED MORPHOLOGY is the decisive pathological marker.
Fiber_Mastication_And_Particle_Length: Dry, compacted, tightly compressed fiber strands; crumbles into fibrous chunks under pressure.
Gas_Bubbles_Foam_Morphology: STRICTLY BUBBLE-FREE.
Mucus_Fibrin_And_Blood_Morphology: Pellets frequently carry a thin glistening mucous glaze deposited during painful straining in the terminal rectum.
Freshness_Vs_Sun_Crust_Gate: Pellets are formed INSIDE the rectum prior to defecation; dry interior confirms true clinical stasis rather than surface weathering.
Mandatory_Visual_Inclusions: DISCRETE OVAL PELLETED BALLS / SEGMENTED LUMPS resembling horse manure; total loss of pat cohesion.
Mandatory_Visual_Exclusions: ABSENCE of continuous flat or stacked pat; ABSENCE of jagged cracked surface fissures.
Primary_Structural_Discriminator: Segmentation into discrete horse-like fecal balls (gut stasis / LDA / milk fever).
Visual_Lookalike_Discriminator: vs 5-E-D: 5-E-D retains continuous pat outline with deep through-fissures from heat dehydration; 5-E-M has completely lost pat outline into discrete separate balls.
Strict_Negative_Exclusion_Logic: IF dung forms a continuous circular pat or pancake -> NEVER assign 5-E-M. IF dung is liquid or pasty -> NEVER assign 5-E-M.
Camera_Bias_And_Confounder_Gates: FRESH COW GATE: Must determine if cow is within 30 days post-calving (LDA/milk fever risk). If dry cow, reclassifies to 5-DRY.
Animal_Context_Gate: Freshly calved dairy cows (0 to 30 days in milk DIM); high risk for metabolic disease.
Diagnosed_Clinical_Condition: Metabolic Shock / Severe Cecal Atony & Gut Stasis (Left Displaced Abomasum LDA / Hypocalcemia / Ketosis).
Root_Cause_Etiology: Profound reduction in gastrointestinal motility (abomasal/ruminal atony) caused by hypocalcemia (subclinical milk fever), endotoxemia (acute metritis/mastitis), or anatomical obstruction (Left Displaced Abomasum LDA). Digesta resides in the colon for >72-96 hours, desiccating into discrete horse-like balls.
Milk_Withdrawal_Risk: YES if systemic antibiotics or surgical drugs administered
Evidence_Basis: DOC + WEB-CORROBORATED (fecal balls / equine-like dung in fresh cows as classic sign of LDA, cecal dilation, or severe hypocalcemia)
On_Farm_Confirmatory_Check: EMERGENCY FRESH COW EXAM: Auscultate left flank with stethoscope and flick ribs for high-pitched musical 'ping' (confirms LDA). Check rectal temperature, test urine/milk for ketone bodies (BHB > 1.4 mmol/L confirms ketosis), and assess ear temperature (cold ears = hypocalcemia).
Actionable_Advice: EMERGENCY VETERINARY ATTENTION REQUIRED. Do not force-feed grain. Check for LDA surgery requirement. Administer IV/subcutaneous calcium borogluconate under veterinary direction if hypocalcemic. Drench with oral rehydration fluids and propylene glycol for ketosis.
Abstain_Escalate_If: Cow is confirmed healthy dry cow -> reclassify as 5-DRY.

Geometry_3D_Form: Hard, dense, fractured dung chunks stacking 2.0 to 3.5 inches in vertical height (50-90 mm); deep through-fissures penetrate the entire mass.
Top_Down_2D_Contour_Signature: Continuous circular pat outline shattered by deep, gaping through-and-through fracture canyons into irregular polygonal blocks.
Central_Dimple_Morphology: Completely absent; shattered into deep fracture crevasses.
Perimeter_Edge_Slope: Steep fractured vertical cliff walls (> 75 degrees).
Texture_And_Moisture_Class: Hard, dense, moisture-depleted fibrous blocks; dry throughout.
Radial_Bleed_Ring_Extent: ZERO BLEEDING. Zero moisture transfer to substrate.
Substrate_Floor_Interaction: Sits like hard cracked clay or dry peat on concrete or dirt floor.
Surface_Optical_Reflectance: Chalky, dull, desiccated matte appearance.
Biological_Sheen_Vs_Flash_Glare_Rule: Completely non-reflective matte surface. Flash produces white glints on dry fibrous edges; verify total absence of wet sheen.
Hex_Range: #5B442B Baked Clay Brown -> #7A623E Dried Earth Khaki
LAB_Centroids: #5B442B=(31.8, 8.4, 18.5); #7A623E=(42.5, 6.8, 24.2) | tolerance dE2000<=12 under a calibrated reference; <=20 uncalibrated
Dietary_Color_Confounder_Disambiguation: Baked clay color reflects severe whole-body dehydration and colonic water extraction.
Fiber_Mastication_And_Particle_Length: Dry, brittle, compressed straw fibers; crumbles into dry powder under footwear.
Gas_Bubbles_Foam_Morphology: STRICTLY BUBBLE-FREE.
Mucus_Fibrin_And_Blood_Morphology: Dry fibrous matrix; occasional thin dry mucus glazing.
Freshness_Vs_Sun_Crust_Gate: FRESHNESS GATE IS CRITICAL: Break open a chunk with a stick: in true 5-E-D, the INTERIOR is completely dry and fractured. In a sun-baked normal pat, the interior remains soft and moist!
Mandatory_Visual_Inclusions: DEEP THROUGH-AND-THROUGH FRACTURE CREVICES; hard dry polygonal blocks; total absence of free moisture in interior.
Mandatory_Visual_Exclusions: ABSENCE of soft/moist interior core; ABSENCE of liquid bleed ring; ABSENCE of gas bubbles.
Primary_Structural_Discriminator: Deep through-and-through fracture canyons in a dry, rock-hard dung mass.
Visual_Lookalike_Discriminator: vs 5-E-M: 5-E-M is separated into discrete round balls; 5-E-D forms an intact pat mass with deep fracture canyons. vs sun-baked Score 3: sun-baked Score 3 has a thin top skin over moist porridge; 5-E-D is dry through-and-through.
Strict_Negative_Exclusion_Logic: IF breaking the crust reveals moist soft porridge inside -> NEVER assign 5-E-D (reclassify as sun-baked Score 3 or 4).
Camera_Bias_And_Confounder_Gates: CRITICAL WEATHERING GATE: Sun-dried pats on hot concrete mimic 5-E-D. Must verify sample is fresh or internal core is dry.
Animal_Context_Gate: Cattle of any breed exposed to severe heat stress (Indian summer >40°C), water trough failure, or water deprivation.
Diagnosed_Clinical_Condition: Severe Whole-Body Dehydration / Heat Stress Water Crisis.
Root_Cause_Etiology: Extreme physiological dehydration resulting from ambient heat stress, water trough failure, frozen pipes, or high-salinity water rejection. Kidneys and colon maximally conserve water, stripping all possible moisture from the digesta.
Evidence_Basis: DOC + WEB-CORROBORATED (severe dehydration causing dry fecal impaction and colonic water resorption)
On_Farm_Confirmatory_Check: EMERGENCY WATER CHECK: Inspect water troughs immediately (flow rate, cleanliness, temperature). Perform skin-tent test (>4 seconds indicates >10% dehydration). Check for sunken eyeballs and panting score.
Actionable_Advice: IMMEDIATE WATER ACCESS: Check and clean all water troughs. Ensure cool, shaded, fresh drinking water with minimum flow rate of 20 liters/minute. If cows are severely dehydrated, do not allow sudden engorgement (water intoxication risk): offer 15-20 liters every 30 minutes. Provide electrolyte salts. Severely dehydrated recumbent cows require veterinary IV fluids.
Abstain_Escalate_If: Sample was dropped > 4 hours ago under direct sun -> abstain, request a freshly dropped sample.

Geometry_3D_Form: Firm segmented dry stack passed in NORMAL VOLUME (height 2.0 to 3.5 inches); defined segmented rolls or thick segmented tiers.
Top_Down_2D_Contour_Signature: Substantial, heavy, segmented dung mass with deep surface grooving; holds circular boundary without flowing.
Central_Dimple_Morphology: Completely absent; forms a heavy segmented mound.
Perimeter_Edge_Slope: Steep rounded cliff walls (60 to 75 degrees).
Texture_And_Moisture_Class: Firm, dense, fibrous texture; moisture is low but holds together cleanly without crumbling into dust.
Radial_Bleed_Ring_Extent: ZERO BLEEDING. Zero fluid separation.
Substrate_Floor_Interaction: Rests cleanly on straw bedding or dirt; does not stick or spread.
Surface_Optical_Reflectance: Dull matte fibrous sheen.
Biological_Sheen_Vs_Flash_Glare_Rule: Natural matte surface. Flash produces white glints on dry fibrous ridges; recognize dry cow roughage diet.
Hex_Range: #514332 Rich Straw Brown -> #423829 Deep Earth Brown
LAB_Centroids: #514332=(29.5, 4.8, 12.8); #423829=(24.2, 3.5, 10.5) | tolerance dE2000<=12 under a calibrated reference; <=20 uncalibrated
Dietary_Color_Confounder_Disambiguation: Rich straw brown reflects high fiber, low energy dry-cow maintenance ration. 100% PHYSIOLOGICAL AND SAFE FOR DRY COWS.
Fiber_Mastication_And_Particle_Length: Dense masticated straw fibers (0.25 to 0.75 in / 6 to 19 mm); well digested dry roughage.
Gas_Bubbles_Foam_Morphology: STRICTLY BUBBLE-FREE.
Mucus_Fibrin_And_Blood_Morphology: Clean fibrous matrix; absence of blood or acute mucus.
Freshness_Vs_Sun_Crust_Gate: Maintains firm, dense structure cleanly over several hours.
Mandatory_Visual_Inclusions: DRY COW / FAR-OFF GROUP; firm segmented mound height 2.0-3.5 in; normal high fecal volume; dull matte surface.
Mandatory_Visual_Exclusions: MUST NOT BE FRESH LACTATING COW; ABSENCE of tiny isolated horse pellets (5-E-M); ABSENCE of fluid bleed ring.
Primary_Structural_Discriminator: Firm segmented stack (2.0-3.5 in) in NORMAL VOLUME in a healthy pregnant dry cow.
Visual_Lookalike_Discriminator: vs 5-E-M: 5-E-M is passed in tiny volume as separate horse-like balls in sick fresh cows; 5-DRY is passed in full normal volume by healthy dry cows. vs 4-S-W: 5-DRY is firmer and more segmented.
Strict_Negative_Exclusion_Logic: IF cow is in early lactation (<60 DIM) -> NEVER assign 5-DRY (assign 4-S-W or 5-E-M).
Camera_Bias_And_Confounder_Gates: PRODUCTION GROUP GATE IS MANDATORY: Confirm animal is a pregnant dry cow (far-off dry period).
Animal_Context_Gate: Pregnant, non-lactating dry cows (far-off dry period, 60 to 21 days before expected calving).
Diagnosed_Clinical_Condition: Normal Physiological Baseline (Far-Off Dry Cow).
Root_Cause_Etiology: Far-off dry cows are fed high-fiber, low-energy, controlled-protein diets (bulky straw/hay + low potassium forage) to maintain rumen volume, prevent obesity, and prepare rumen papillae for transition.
Evidence_Basis: DOC + WEB-CORROBORATED (Zaaijer & Noordhuizen: Score 4-5 is normal target for far-off dry dairy cows)
On_Farm_Confirmatory_Check: Confirm animal is in dry cow pen. Confirm body condition score (BCS) is between 3.0 and 3.5 (prevent over-conditioning).
Actionable_Advice: Optimal normal baseline for far-off dry cows. Continue current controlled-energy dry cow ration. Ensure transition to close-up ration at 21 days before calving.
Abstain_Escalate_If: Animal is a high-yielding milking cow -> reclassify as 4-S-W.

Geometry_3D_Form: FAECAL OUTPUT NEARLY ABSENT: rectum is virtually empty; only tiny, scant (1-2 tablespoons) tenacious jelly clots passed.
Top_Down_2D_Contour_Signature: Small, scant, glistening blob of dark purple-black or clotted maroon jelly, completely lacking regular dung volume.
Central_Dimple_Morphology: Completely absent; amorphous clot mass.
Perimeter_Edge_Slope: Steep rounded gelatinous borders.
Texture_And_Moisture_Class: Dense, gelatinous, rubbery blackberry-jelly consistency; thick coagulated blood and fibrin.
Radial_Bleed_Ring_Extent: Dark reddish/purple serum ring staining surrounding concrete or bedding.
Substrate_Floor_Interaction: Adheres like thick blackberry jam to concrete or straw; scant total volume.
Surface_Optical_Reflectance: High glistening specular reflection from thick gelatinous clot surfaces.
Biological_Sheen_Vs_Flash_Glare_Rule: Gelatinous blood clots produce rich, deep specular highlights. Flash glare creates white points; look at dark maroon/black jelly body.
Hex_Range: #2A0808 Deep Blackberry -> #1A0505 Near Black / Clotted Maroon
LAB_Centroids: #2A0808=(10.5, 14.8, 8.2); #1A0505=(6.2, 8.5, 4.1) | tolerance dE2000<=12 under a calibrated reference; <=20 uncalibrated
Dietary_Color_Confounder_Disambiguation: Dark blackberry-jelly color is caused by massive intraluminal blood clotting within the jejunum. Decisive diagnostic key is SCANT NEAR-ABSENT OUTPUT + BLOOD CLOT.
Fiber_Mastication_And_Particle_Length: Fecal fiber is virtually absent; composed entirely of coagulated intraluminal blood clots and fibrin.
Gas_Bubbles_Foam_Morphology: STRICTLY BUBBLE-FREE.
Mucus_Fibrin_And_Blood_Morphology: MANDATORY MASSIVE COAGULATED BLOOD: Thick, rubbery, dark blackberry-jelly blood clots with heavy fibrin scaffolding.
Freshness_Vs_Sun_Crust_Gate: Clot remains shiny and rubbery for 30-45 minutes before drying to dark crust.
Mandatory_Visual_Inclusions: SCANT NEAR-ZERO OUTPUT (< 2 tablespoons); thick dark blackberry-jelly coagulated blood clots; absence of normal fecal volume.
Mandatory_Visual_Exclusions: ABSENCE of normal fecal pad; ABSENCE of watery liquid spray (Score 1).
Primary_Structural_Discriminator: Scant blackberry-jelly blood clots with near-total absence of fecal output (HBS jejunal obstruction).
Visual_Lookalike_Discriminator: vs 1-RED: 1-RED is passed in high volume with liquid watery fecal base; 5-HBS has near-absent volume, dry empty rectum, and thick dark bramble-jelly clots.
Strict_Negative_Exclusion_Logic: IF fecal volume is normal (> 2 kg) or watery liquid -> NEVER assign 5-HBS (consider 1-RED).
Camera_Bias_And_Confounder_Gates: Correlate with acute systemic colic signs (treading feet, kicking belly, pale gums).
Animal_Context_Gate: High-producing adult dairy cows in early to peak lactation (first 100 DIM).
Diagnosed_Clinical_Condition: Haemorrhagic Bowel Syndrome (HBS / Jejunal Haemorrhage Syndrome JHS / Clostridium perfringens type A).
Root_Cause_Etiology: Sudden massive localized intraluminal hemorrhage in the jejunum/ileum, driven by Clostridium perfringens type A and Aspergillus fumigatus toxins, forming an expansive obstructing blood clot that physically occludes the intestinal lumen.
Evidence_Basis: DOC + WEB-CORROBORATED (HBS classic pathology: intraluminal jejunal blood clot, complete ileus, scant blackberry-jam feces, >85% fatality without immediate intervention)
On_Farm_Confirmatory_Check: EMERGENCY VET CHECK: Transrectal palpation reveals empty rectum with tacky dark clot residue and distended loops of small intestine. Severe colic (kicking at abdomen, tachycardia >90 bpm).
Actionable_Advice: LIFE-THREATENING EMERGENCY: Immediate veterinary attendance. High mortality rate (>80%). Treatment requires immediate surgical laparotomy and jejunal clot massage/enterectomy or intensive medical therapy (IV fluids, analgesia, antimicrobial therapy for C. perfringens).
Abstain_Escalate_If: Output is copious and watery liquid -> reclassify as 1-RED.
